packet.title: JSON, parse-xml and adaptive output (implementation)
packet.summary: Implements JSON parsing and conversion (parse-json, json-to-xml, xml-to-json), parse-xml and the adaptive serializer of serialize.h.

body.p: After , , . Owns src/json.c, src/function_library_json.c, src/serialize.c, tests/json_test.c, tests/serialize_test.c. parse-json (options duplicates, null, number-format; FOJS0001), json-to-xml, xml-to-json (FOJS0006), jtree, parse-xml; serialize.h. Done when the JSON slice lines pass as unit cases. Spec: F&O 4.0 "Functions on JSON data"; RFC 8259; Serialization 4.0 "Adaptive output method". Done 2026-10-16 (): tree-sitter grammar grammars/json; 22 slice lines as unit cases in tests/json_test.c; fallback functions not yet.
